verdict.summary: The complete two-file diff was reviewed against issue #426 and trusted policy. Workflow provenance binding is substantially improved, but check-suite evidence is collected without being enforced, leaving the required suite-state consistency acceptance criterion uncovered.

blockingFindings.title: Trusted gates are not bound to consistent check-suite state
blockingFindings.details: scanCompleteCheckRuns records each suite's app, status, conclusion, and latest_check_runs_count, but listCompleteSuiteCheckRunsOnce only verifies the suite ID on each check run, and isTrustedPolicyWorkflowRun receives no suite evidence. Consequently a selected Actions check can be marked trusted and green even when its containing suite has a different app, is incomplete or failed, or declares a latest-check count inconsistent with the enumerated runs. This does not satisfy issue #426's requirement to bind the gates to check-suite identity and consistent run state. Preserve the suite metadata alongside each run and fail closed unless the suite app matches the check-run app, the latest count matches the complete filtered inventory, and relevant suite/run state is consistent; add focused mismatch tests.

nonBlockingNotes: The new tests cover pagination, duplicate and malformed inventory evidence, two-pass mutation detection, wrong workflow provenance, and ambiguous workflow-run bindings.
Independent exact-head command execution remains owned by the separate Validate gate and was not treated as missing review evidence.
